verdict.rationale: Bento is an observability and improvement platform for AI agents, so an in-product assistant is a fair axis, but the evidence shows no built-in assistant that users delegate tasks to. The closest items are adjacent and earn no credit: Agent Skills that run inside external coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, and others), plain-English signal and alert definitions, and automated incident judging. None of these is a conversational assistant inside Bento that accepts delegated tasks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
